01 · The Idea

The real Baseline

The Baseline is my first album, and it is more than a title. It is the real Baseline of my life: the foundation of my character and my mindset. Hip-hop and rap saved my life. They felt like a father, a brother and a friend, and every time I listen I feel powerful, like my true self.

I have loved rap since I was about 11 or 12. For years I wrote and made music in secret, filling notebooks and papers I never showed anyone. I started releasing music professionally at 19. Music is where I met myself. It is where I belong.

“I only feel alive when I write, I rap, I create.”H.wise Deep

02 · The Baseline

What is The Baseline

A baseline is the starting point, the line everything else is measured from. The Baseline is the foundation of my character and my mindset, the place I return to. It is not about being better than anyone. It is about being my true self.

I made The Baseline with what I had. I grow with The Baseline, and I’m grateful for everything God has given me. I’m also grateful to the artists who inspired me: Eminem, J. Cole, Nipsey Hussle, Dr. Dre, Jay-Z and Nas.

The Baseline Story

03 · The Search

Music is everything

Music is everything for me. It taught me to correct myself. I dropped my ego and started learning from everyone, and I began to respect every single thing, big or small.

Now I try to breathe with joy and without worry, and to accept whatever comes. I believe God is everywhere, the universal mind, and I’m grateful for everything. Thank you, God.

Nanak says.

04 · The Old Me

Letting the old self die

For my first sixteen years I lived on other people’s beliefs, like a puppet of society and appearances, running on survival and negativity. I wasn’t conscious. Around sixteen and seventeen I started to see I was wasting my life. By the start of nineteen, I let that old self die, including the name I was born with, and I created myself again. H.wise Deep is who I chose to be. Now I’m free, and I’m grateful that God showed me these truths. Life is important.

Waheguru ji.

05 · The Name

H.wise Deep and Atch

I am H.wise Deep, the one who remembers God. I do not get caught up in physical attachments, relationships and duties. I believe in the creator and in the universal truth, and I follow Guru Nanak, all ten Sikh Gurus, and the current Guru, Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. I’m more than a label. I’m a part of the universe, born alone and returning to God. The name is a reminder of that truth.

There are two sides to me. H.wise Deep is my masculine side: deeply spiritual, serious and disciplined, focused only on the self, always creating and finding ways to improve. Atch is my feminine side: free, even while I remember God. I am like a kid with no worries and no hate, who does not discriminate and enjoys every moment of life. Every person carries both a feminine and a masculine energy, and I carry both.

Waheguru ji.

06 · The Beginning

The Beginning

This is the setup I used to record, a year ago, on an iPhone 11. The whole Baseline, from making and producing to mixing and mastering, was done on an iPhone.

“Success is for me, doing my best.”H.wise Deep
